referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The filler was modelled based on the following composition: 57% quartz sand, 30% limestone, 7% feldspar, and 6% dolomite. The composition of the filler is based on a test report on the mineralogy of filler from Fabrique d’agglomérés Monthey SA and was taken from the research project ‘Life Cycle Assessment of Asphalt Pavements’ of the platform ‘Gravel for Generations’. For the milling process of dolomite, quartz sand, and feldspar, the same effort as for limestone was assumed.
